The frozen source defines the rule fingerprint as “content‑addressed within ruleset_content_hash lineage” but does not require the fingerprint to be computed over a canonical, order‑independent ordering of rules. Smallest correction: make rule‑fingerprint computation order‑independent (e.g., sort rule IDs before hashing) so that the fingerprint is invariant under permutation, guaranteeing the emission identity required by AT‑I6c.

REVISE
